properties.description: The color or color combination of the interior of the vehicle.

properties.label: vehicleInteriorType
properties.description: The type or material of the interior of the vehicle (e.g. synthetic fabric, leather, wood, etc.). While most interior types are characterized by the material used, an interior type can also be based on vehicle usage or target audience.

properties.label: vehicleModelDate
properties.description: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

properties.label: vehicleSeatingCapacity
properties.description: The number of passengers that can be seated in the vehicle, both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

properties.label: vehicleSpecialUsage
properties.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi. The legislation in many countries requires this information to be revealed when offering a car for sale.

properties.label: vehicleTransmission
properties.description: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or other relevant component(s) ("gearbox" for cars).

properties.label: vendor
properties.description: 'vendor' is an earlier term for 'seller'.

properties.label: verificationFactCheckingPolicy
properties.description: Disclosure about verification and fact-checking processes for a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other fact-checking [[Organization]].

properties.label: version
properties.description: The version of the CreativeWork embodied by a specified resource.

properties.label: video
properties.description: An embedded video object.

properties.label: videoFormat
properties.description: The type of screening or video broadcast used (e.g. IMAX, 3D, SD, HD, etc.).

properties.label: videoFrameSize
properties.description: The frame size of the video.

properties.label: videoQuality
properties.description: The quality of the video.

properties.label: volumeNumber
properties.description: Identifies the volume of publication or multi-part work; for example, "iii" or "2".

properties.label: warning
properties.description: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug (text or URL).

properties.label: warranty
properties.description: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

properties.label: warrantyPromise
properties.description: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

properties.label: warrantyScope
properties.description: The scope of the warranty promise.

properties.label: webCheckinTime
properties.description: The time when a passenger can check into the flight online.

properties.label: webFeed
properties.description: The URL for a feed, e.g. associated with a podcast series, blog, or series of date-stamped updates. This is usually RSS or Atom.

properties.label: weight
properties.description: The weight of the product or person.

properties.label: weightPercentage
properties.description: Value representing the fraction of the weight that is used to compute the shipping price. Example: 0.10 and a shipping weight of 15kg would add $1.5 to the order price, where the $ is the currency of the order.

properties.label: weightTotal
properties.description:
The permitted total weight of the loaded vehicle, including passengers and cargo and the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

properties.label: wheelbase
properties.description: The distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels.\n\nTypical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet.

properties.label: width
properties.description: The width of the item.

properties.label: winner
properties.description: A sub property of participant. The winner of the action.

properties.label: wordCount
properties.description: The number of words in the text of the CreativeWork such as an Article, Book, etc.

properties.label: workExample
properties.description: Example/instance/realization/derivation of the concept of this creative work. E.g. the paperback edition, first edition, or e-book.

properties.label: workFeatured
properties.description: A work featured in some event, e.g. exhibited in an ExhibitionEvent. Specific subproperties are available for workPerformed (e.g. a play), or a workPresented (a Movie at a ScreeningEvent).

properties.label: workHours
properties.description: The typical working hours for this job (e.g. 1st shift, night shift, 8am-5pm).

properties.label: workload
properties.description: Quantitative measure of the physiologic output of the exercise; also referred to as energy expenditure.

properties.label: workLocation
properties.description: A contact location for a person's place of work.

properties.label: workPerformed
properties.description: A work performed in some event, for example a play performed in a TheaterEvent.

properties.label: workPresented
properties.description: The movie presented during this event.

properties.label: worksFor
properties.description: Organizations that the person works for.

properties.label: workTranslation
properties.description: A work that is a translation of the content of this work. E.g. 西遊記 has an English workTranslation “Journey to the West”, a German workTranslation “Monkeys Pilgerfahrt” and a Vietnamese translation Tây du ký bình khảo.

properties.label: worstRating
properties.description: The lowest value allowed in this rating system.

properties.label: xpath
properties.description: An XPath, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

properties.label: yearBuilt
properties.description: The year an [[Accommodation]] was constructed. This corresponds to the YearBuilt field in RESO.

properties.label: yearlyRevenue
properties.description: The size of the business in annual revenue.

properties.label: yearsInOperation
properties.description: The age of the business.

properties.label: yield
properties.description: The quantity that results by performing instructions. For example, a paper airplane, 10 personalized candles.
